cn-gb-11552._why: Interior protrusion standard, modified adoption of ECE R21 (record summary says so); no pedestrian/bumper content; R127 already dropped.

cn-gb-11562.summary: GB 11562-2025 sets requirements and measurement methods for the driver's forward direct field of view of light-duty vehicles (M1 and N1). It applies from 2027-01-01 and replaces GB 11562-2014.

cn-gb-11566.summary: GB 11566-2024 specifies requirements for external projections of passenger cars (M1) to reduce injury to pedestrians and other road users from vehicle exterior protrusions. It applies to new type approvals from 2026-01-01.
cn-gb-11566._why: Existing summary is generic body-in-white boilerplate; scope M1 external projections.

cn-gb-13057.summary: GB 13057-2023 specifies strength requirements and tests for seats and their vehicle anchorages in buses (客车). It applies from 2024-01-01.
cn-gb-13057._why: Summary still described passenger-vehicle seats and child restraints; title/categories/UN already fixed.

cn-gb-1495-2002._why: GB 1495-2002 is accelerating pass-by exterior noise limits for M/N vehicles; no AVAS/horn/emissions/pedestrian content; motorcycles covered by GB 16169; R51 already in un_equivalent. open_tags 'AVAS' and body 'Noise and AVAS' not patchable here.

cn-gb-15084-2022._why: Indirect vision counterpart is R46 (already in un_equivalent); R125 is forward field of vision.

cn-gb-15085-2013._why: UN R45 is headlamp cleaners, not windscreen wipers/washers.

cn-gb-27999._why: Fuel consumption evaluation standard; fuel safety/OBD out of scope.

cn-gb-44497.title: Intelligent and connected vehicles - Data recording system for automated driving
cn-gb-44497.summary: GB 44497-2024 specifies requirements for data recording systems of automated-driving vehicles, including data recording, storage and readout, information security, crashworthiness and environmental requirements. It applies from 2026-01-01.
cn-gb-44497._why: Official title is 自动驾驶数据记录系统; R155 removed; R157 (DSSAD)/R160 (EDR) partial analogues.

cn-gb-5920-2024.summary: GB 5920-2024 covers light-signalling devices and systems for motor vehicles (M, N) and their trailers (O), such as position, stop, turn-signal, daytime running and rear fog lamps. Headlamps are covered by GB 4599-2024.
cn-gb-5920-2024._why: Summary copied headlamp boilerplate; R148 is only a broad analogue (not stated by record), so moved to AI field; R48 is installation (GB 4785).

cn-gb-7258-2017.summary: GB 7258-2017 sets technical conditions for the operational safety of power-driven vehicles on roads, with whole-vehicle and main-assembly safety requirements such as dimensions, brakes, steering, lighting and tyres.
cn-gb-7258-2017._why: Summary described conformity/production controls; standard is 机动车运行安全技术条件.

cn-gb-8410._why: Interior-material burn-rate standard; HVAC/Batteries and R21 not applicable; no matching systems tag.

cn-gb-t-20913-2007.summary: GB/T 20913-2007 is the recommended standard for occupant protection in offset frontal collisions of passenger cars, specifying an offset deformable barrier crash test and occupant injury criteria.

cn-gb-t-30512-2014.summary: GB/T 30512-2014 is a recommended standard restricting lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB and PBDE in vehicles and their parts above specified limits.
cn-gb-t-30512-2014._why: Existing summary claimed supplier declarations/recycling info; substances list from finding evidence.
